images.description: Soft blue/green abstract blur for calm background moments, like the AI suggestions screen
Minimalist receipt for empty state of transactions list
Plant growing for budget success or savings achieved

screens_and_features.dashboard: Thumb-zone bottom navigation. Top area shows current weekly spend in large typography (Outfit). Quick 'Add Expense' floating action button or prominent card. Recent transactions listed below with clean minimalist rows.
screens_and_features.add_expense: Focuses heavily on the amount input first (huge text), followed by category chips horizontally scrollable. Includes date picker and notes.
screens_and_features.ai_suggestions: Uses the calm abstract background with glassmorphism cards (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl). Provides narrative data storytelling (e.g., 'You spent 20% less on food this week').
screens_and_features.stats: Donut chart for categories, bar chart for daily breakdown. Use Shadcn charts or Recharts. Colors of chart slices should use variations of primary and secondary, avoiding jarring neon colors.
screens_and_features.budget_alert: If nearing limit, show a sticky top banner or inline card using the 'warning' card style (Terracotta accent).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing on a mobile-first experience. Use the specified generic mobile layout with bottom navigation.
Rely heavily on 'Outfit' font for numbers and headers to ensure a modern, polished look.
Ensure all buttons and touchable areas have a minimum height of 48px for mobile accessibility.
Do NOT use pure black or generic blue. Follow the Organic & Earthy color palette.
Use Shadcn UI where applicable, customizing the border radius to rounded-3xl for cards.
Ensure the budget limit notification uses the warning palette (#C05746) to provide clear contrast and urgency without being overly aggressive.
